metadata.dataset: NASA Artemis Surface Architecture & ECLSS Technical Specifications
metadata.source: NASA Human Exploration and Operations Mission Directorate (HEOMD) & NASA Glenn Research Center

modules.name: Vertical Solar Array Technology (VSAT)
modules.whyThisIsReal: NASA Vertical Solar Array Technology (VSAT) contracts deploy 10-meter-tall solar arrays on telescoping masts to capture low-incident polar sunlight over crater rims without casting ground shadows.
modules.formula: P = S(r) * A * eta * cos(theta) * (1 - dust)
modules.source: NASA Space Technology Mission Directorate (STMD) VSAT Project

modules.name: Regenerative Li-Ion Battery Storage (100 kWh)
modules.whyThisIsReal: Space-rated Lithium-Iron-Phosphate (LFP) battery systems provide essential power during orbital eclipse or seasonal crater peak shadows, with thermal jacket heaters to prevent freeze-damage.
modules.source: NASA Battery Safety Workshop / Glenn Research Center

modules.name: Pressurized Surface Habitat (4-Crew)
modules.whyThisIsReal: Based on NASA TransHab multi-layer Kevlar and Nextel inflatable pressure shell architecture. Provides 120 m^3 of living space, private crew quarters, galley, and medical station.
modules.formula: P_internal = 101.3 kPa, V = 120 m^3, Q_loss = A * (T_int - T_ext) / R
modules.source: NASA TransHab Concept / Artemis Foundation Habitat Study

modules.name: ECLSS Closed-Loop Air & Water Processor
modules.whyThisIsReal: The ISS Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) uses Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly (CDRA), Oxygen Generation Assembly (OGA), and Vacuum Distillation to recycle 93%+ of astronaut urine and washwater.
modules.source: NASA Marshall Space Flight Center ECLSS Branch

modules.name: Pressurized Rover Garage & Charging Bay
modules.whyThisIsReal: Lunar rovers like NASA's Lunar Terrain Vehicle (LTV) and pressurized rovers need dust blowdown bays, inductive fast charging, and micrometeorite protection between exploration sorties.
modules.source: NASA Lunar Terrain Vehicle (LTV) Ground Operations

modules.name: Sublimation Ice Drill & Condenser Rig
modules.whyThisIsReal: Permanently shadowed crater ice is frozen hard as granite at 40K. Thermal coring drills heat the icy regolith inside a sealed capture dome, vacuum-channeling water vapor into cold traps for condensation.
modules.formula: Q_sublimation = m_ice * (c_p * DeltaT + DeltaH_sublimation), DeltaH_sub = 2.83 MJ/kg
modules.source: NASA PRIME-1 (Polar Resources Ice Mining Experiment-1)

modules.name: Molten Regolith Electrolysis (MRE) Oxygen Smelter
modules.whyThisIsReal: Lunar regolith is ~43% oxygen by mass. Heating regolith to 1600°C and applying an electrical current through iridium electrodes extracts pure O2 gas while leaving molten iron, aluminum, and silicon for construction.
modules.source: NASA Marshall Space Flight Center ISRU Technology Project

modules.name: Kilopower KRUSTY Nuclear Fission Reactor (10 kWe)
modules.whyThisIsReal: NASA Kilopower (KRUSTY - Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology) uses an enriched U-235 cast core with sodium heat pipes driving high-efficiency Stirling engines to deliver unyielding continuous power through 14-day lunar nights.
modules.formula: P_out = Q_nuclear * eta_stirling, eta_stirling = 1 - T_cold / T_hot
modules.source: NASA / Los Alamos National Laboratory Kilopower KRUSTY Experiment

modules.name: Microwave Regolith Sintering 3D Construction Drone
modules.whyThisIsReal: Nanophase iron in lunar regolith couples strongly with 2.45 GHz microwave radiation. Autonomous rovers sinter unrefined dust into interlocking solid pavers, blast walls, and radiation berms.
modules.source: NASA Centennial Challenges / ICON 3D Lunar Construction

modules.name: High-Gain Ka-Band / Optical Laser Terminal
modules.whyThisIsReal: Optical communications (like NASA's DSOC on Psyche) and Ka-band antennas provide gigabit science downlink to NASA's Deep Space Network dishes in Goldstone, Madrid, and Canberra.
modules.formula: P_rx = P_tx * G_tx * G_rx * (lambda / (4 * pi * R))^2 (Friis transmission equation)
modules.source: NASA Deep Space Optical Communications (DSOC) Project

modules.name: Zero-Boil-Off Cryogenic Propellant Storage (LOX/LH2)
modules.whyThisIsReal: Liquid hydrogen (20K) and oxygen (90K) boil off rapidly in space heat. NASA Cryogenic Fluid Management (CFM) uses 90-layer MLI, active pulse-tube cryocoolers, and sunshields to preserve propellant for return rockets.
modules.source: NASA STMD Cryogenic Fluid Management (CFM) Portfolio

modules.name: MOXIE Atmospheric CO2 Solid Oxide Electrolyzer
modules.whyThisIsReal: Tested on Mars aboard Perseverance, the Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment (MOXIE) intakes thin 95% CO2 air, filters dust, compresses it, and electrochemically splits CO2 into carbon monoxide and breathable oxygen at 800°C.
modules.formula: 2CO2 -> 2CO + O2 (SOXE cell operating at 800 deg C)
modules.source: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance / MIT MOXIE Team
